stem.en: A row of a chart shows these five signs for West Asia, from earliest to latest: sedentism, cultivation, livestock, agricultural landscape, pottery. What does this row tell us?

text.en: People in West Asia settled in one place before they grew crops, and they made pottery last.
People in West Asia made pottery first, so that they could store their crops.

feedback.en: Pottery is the last sign in this row, not the first. Pottery came first in the other five regions on the chart.

text.en: People in West Asia grew crops first and settled only after that.

feedback.en: Sedentism, which means settling in one place, stands before cultivation in this row.

text.en: The same five signs came in this same order in every region of the world.

feedback.en: One row cannot show this, and the other rows of the chart show a different order.

explanation.en: Sedentism means settling in one place. It stands first in the row, before cultivation, and pottery stands last.

hints.en: Sedentism means settling in one place. Which sign stands first in the row?
